quarterly_data.quarter: Pfizer press release: Pfizer's LITFULO Significantly Improved Facial and Total (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Phase 3 TRANQUILLO 2 (100 mg, 1,567 adults) and TRANQUILLO (50 mg, 607 patients aged 12+) results for LITFULO (ritlecitinib) in nonsegmental vitiligo, presented at EADV 2026: at Week 52, F-VASI75 was achieved by 21.86% and 12.47% of patients versus 2.40% and 2.48% on placebo, and T-VASI50 by 13.02% and 8.98% versus 2.40% and 1.98%, with no new safety signals. Pfizer intends to submit the data to regulators globally, including the FDA and EMA. Separately, Pfizer has initiated a pivotal study of LITFULO in moderate alopecia areata.
